abstract: INTRODUCTION: To assess whether dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) expression is correlated with the concentration of methotrexate (MTX) exposure and the resistance index during the establishment of MTX-resistant human choriocarcinoma JeG-3 cell line. METHODS: Two series of different MTX-resistant JeG-3 sublines were established by intermittent- and consecutive-inducing methods. Quantitative real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction was used to measure DHFR messenger RNA expression in the sublines during different concentrations of MTX exposure. [beta]-Human chorionic gonadotropin ([beta]-HCG) secretion in these cell lines were detected by using chemoluminescence method. RESULTS: In the 2 series of MTX-resistant cell lines, the same dynamic profiling of [beta]-HCG secretion and DHFR transcript level were found: At a certain range of concentration, the upward [beta]-HCG secretion and the messenger RNA level of DHFR were correlated with the dose of MTX exposing. However, once the concentration of MTX exceeded this range, the expression would not increase but decrease sharply. According to the concentration of MTX exposure from low to high, the multiples of [beta]-HCG increases were 1.86-, 5.15-, 8.38-, 64.17-, 2.6-, and 0.78-fold for intermittent induction and 22.05-, 6.12-, 5.80-, and 1.77-fold for continuous induction; the multiples of DHFR gene expression increases were 12.84-, 99.02-, 129.01-, 177.63-, 420.78-, and 86.09-fold for intermittent induction and 9.59-, 20.56-, 96.05-, and 58.72-fold for continuous induction. CONCLUSIONS: The transcript level of DHFR gene only correlated with MTX drug resistance at a certain phase. It would be of limited use as a biomarker for the MTX-based chemoresistance prediction.
abstract_ja: 目的：絨毛癌JeG-3細胞株におけるMTX耐性の確立の過程で、ジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素(DHFR)発現がMTX曝露濃度および耐性指数と相関するかを検討すること。方法：間欠誘導法と連続誘導法により、MTX耐性JeG-3亜株の2系列を樹立した。定量的リアルタイム逆転写ポリメラーゼ連鎖反応を用いて、異なるMTX濃度への曝露中の亜株におけるDHFRメッセンジャーRNA発現を測定した。化学発光法を用いて、これらの細胞株におけるβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌を検出した。結果：MTX耐性細胞株の2系列では、β-hCG分泌とDHFR転写産物量に同様の動態が認められた。ある濃度範囲では、MTX曝露量の増加とともにβ-hCG分泌およびDHFRのmRNA量が上昇したが、その範囲を超えると発現は上昇せず、急激に低下した。MTX曝露濃度の低い順から、β-hCGの増加倍率は間欠誘導で1.86、5.15、8.38、64.17、2.6、0.78倍、連続誘導で22.05、6.12、5.80、1.77倍であった。DHFR遺伝子発現の増加倍率は間欠誘導で12.84、99.02、129.01、177.63、420.78、86.09倍、連続誘導で9.59、20.56、96.05、58.72倍であった。結論：DHFR遺伝子の転写産物量は、特定の段階でのみMTX薬剤耐性と相関した。MTXを基盤とした化学療法耐性予測のバイオマーカーとしての有用性は限られると考えられる。
